title: Card created
description: This event is generated when the Create card, Reissue card, and Start noname card bulk process endpoints are called. This event is generated asynchronously and is sent when the PCI data has been successfully created or failed to be created. Until this event occurs and the card is successfully created, accessing a newly-created card, such as changing the password, will fail. For more information on cards, see the Cards overview guide.

card_hash.title: Hashed PAN
card_hash.description: Hashed Primary Account Number (PAN). For `UNNUMBERED` cards, this field won't appear until the Issuer sets the card's PAN.

card_last_four_numbers.title: Last 4 PAN numbers
card_last_four_numbers.description: Last 4 Primary Account Number (PAN) digits. For `UNNUMBERED` cards, this field won't appear until the Issuer sets the card's PAN.

card_printed_name.title: Cardholder's name printed on physical (plastic/metal) card

contactless_enabled.title: Contactless card flag
contactless_enabled.description: Can card make transactions using contactless entry mode? Default is `true`

embossed.title: Embossing file name
embossed.description: Name of file containing cards to be embossed sent to embosser.

issuing_date.title: Card issued datetime
issuing_date.description: Datetime when card issued - RFC3339 format.

abu_enabled.title: Automatic Billing Update (ABU) flag
abu_enabled.description: Must card number be sent to Mastercard's Automatic Billing Updater service? Default is `true`. Mastercard only.

bulk_id.title: Bulk/batch ID
bulk_id.description: Not null if the card was created as part of a noname bulk/batch

card_bin.title: Card BIN
card_bin.description: Card's Bank Identification Number (BIN), a 6 or 8 digit value. For `UNNUMBERED` cards, this field won't appear until the Issuer sets the card's PAN.

cvv_next_rotation_date.title: Next CVV rotation date.
cvv_next_rotation_date.description: `VIRTUAL` card only. Scheduled datetime (RFC3339 format) for next CVV2/CVC2 value change.

cvv_rotation_type.title: CVV rotation type
cvv_rotation_type.description: `VIRTUAL` card only. Rotation method for CVV2/CVC2 value.

embossing_custom_fields.title: Custom embossing information
embossing_custom_fields.description: Customer information for embossing company such as tracking ID or whether card is plastic or metal

external_id.title: Customer provided ID
external_id.description: Customer provided ID for external tracking purposes

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Customer provided information - no business rule validation is done.

reissued_card_block.title: Information to replace the card in the automatic billing update flow
reissued_card_block.description: Indicates if the card is a replacement account for the Mastercard Automatic Billing Updater service. Mastercard only and only in the reissue Card Flow.

template_id.title: Template ID
template_id.description: Template ID - not null if card creation based on template. Templates are used to implement the BIN override feature. For more information, see the BIN override documentation in the Cards management guide. To create a template, you need to open a Pismo Service Desk request. The ticket type should be **Settings**.

dual_message_debit.title: Dual message debit card flag
dual_message_debit.description: Is card dual message debit?. Default is `false`

validity_period_hours.title: Card validity period in hours
validity_period_hours.description: How long, in hours, the card is valid. Used to calculate `valid_until` for `PLASTIC` and `VIRTUAL` cards.

valid_until.title: Card valid until datetime.
valid_until.description: Datetime (RFC3339 format) when the card is no longer valid. Calculated using `validity_period_hours`. When exceeded, the card's status becomes `INOPERATIVE`.
